transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I guess what brings me in is that I’ve just gotten... really slowed down lately. I'm an auditor, and it's gotten to the point where I can sit there staring at one audit workpaper for twenty minutes before I even move my hand to type. It's like I just can't get going. And people at work have started noticing that I’m not keeping up, so... I knew I needed to come in.
Aside from feeling slowed down, how has your mood been lately?
It's been pretty low. Honestly, most days I just wake up with this... heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It kind of feels like the day is already lost before I've even managed to get out of bed.
How long have you been feeling this low?
It's been going on for about seven months now. It started right around the time my husband stopped working... his company downsized, and he lost his job. I think it's just been since then.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt the opposite—unusually energetic, hyperactive, or like you were on top of the world?
No, I don't think so. I mean, before all this started, I just felt normal. I've never really had a time where I felt unusually energetic or... hyperactive. Just regular, I guess.
Have you noticed that you feel unusually sensitive to the cold lately?
No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean, I get cold sometimes, but... not unusually sensitive to it, no. Just normal, I guess.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you usually enjoy doing?

Yeah, I really have. I used to do a lot of things... I'd plan hikes, take photos, cook big meals on Sundays. I even volunteered at the library. But now, all of those things just feel like... well, like items on a checklist. I just don't care enough to even start them anymore.
Have you ever experienced a period where you felt this down or depressed before in your life?
No, I don't think so. I've had bad days, sure, like anyone else, but... nothing like this. This is the first time I've ever felt this low, where it just doesn't seem to lift.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't really had thoughts of hurting myself. It's more just... feeling empty, I guess. Like things are pointless right now. But I haven't thought about actually doing anything to harm myself.
How has your sleep been over these past few months?

My sleep? Um, it's been mostly fine, I think. I haven't really noticed any big changes with it. I just go to bed and wake up around the same time I always do for work. So, yeah, nothing really stands out there.
